users.bio: Senior practicing advocate specializing in High Court Constitutional Writs (Mandamus when government departments fail to act), Property Partition, and Public Law.
Practicing lawyer before National Green Tribunal (NGT), High Courts, and commercial tribunals for industrial compliance, recovery suites, and trade licenses.
Specialist in matrimonial disputes, mutual consent divorce, 125 CrPC maintenance, anticipatory bail, and Information Commission RTI 2nd appeals.

cases.title: Illegal Encroachment on Ancestral Agricultural Land (Phagwara, Punjab)
cases.summary: Ancestral land measuring 6.5 acres occupied by local land mafia while client was residing in Dubai. Patwari refused mutation (Dakhil Kharij). Urgent stay order (Order 39 CPC) and civil partition suit required.

bids.briefAdvice: We will immediately institute a Title Suit with an urgent Application under Order 39 Rules 1 & 2 CPC to obtain ad-interim injunction against alteration of land status. Parallel representation to DC under Punjab Land Revenue Act.
bids.timeline: Court filing within 48 hours of retainer deposit.

bids.briefAdvice: Prima facie revenue entry manipulation evident. Will move Sub-Divisional Magistrate under Section 145 CrPC for immediate police protection and seal illegal construction on agricultural chunk.
bids.timeline: Interim protection notice drafted in 24 hours.

bids.briefAdvice: The closure order violates audi alteram partem. Will file emergency Original Application before NGT Principal Bench seeking ex-parte stay citing livelihood of 80 workers and compliant ETP reports.
Tender award copies cannot be blanket protected under Section 8(1)(d). Will file CIC 2nd Appeal with Supreme Court precedents on public interest overriding commercial confidence.
